# Function to split a file into N files
function split_file_n() {
         local input_file=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;local num_files=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Bash-Function-Args
  local prefix=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${3:-split_}&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Default prefix is &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;split_&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; || -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num_files&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Usage: split_file_n &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;number_of_files&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; [prefix]&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Error: Input file &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; not found.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if ! [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num_files&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Error: Number of files must be a positive integer.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
      return 1
  fi

  local total_lines=$(wc -l &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
  local lines_per_file=$((total_lines / num_files))
  local remainder=$((total_lines % num_files))

  local start_line=1
  for ((i=1; i&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;=num_files; i++)); do
    local output_file=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${prefix}${i}&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    local current_lines=$lines_per_file

    if [[ $i -le $remainder ]]; then
      ((current_lines++)) # Distribute remainder lines
    fi

    head -n &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$((start_line + current_lines - 1))&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; | tail -n &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$current_lines&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$output_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

    ((start_line += current_lines))
  done
}

function truncate_file_lines() {
         local filename=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;local num_chars=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Bash-Function-Args

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: Filename not provided.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: File &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; not found.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num_chars&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: Number of characters not provided.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if ! [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num_chars&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: Number of characters must be a positive integer.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi
  if [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num_chars&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; == &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;0&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local temp_file=$(mktemp)

  while IFS= read -r line; do
    printf &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;%.${num_chars}s\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$line&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$temp_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  done &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  mv &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$temp_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  return 0
}

function sort_file() {
         local filename=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;; local str=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Bash-Function-Args

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then

  if [[ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$str&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then

  if [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$str&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; == &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
      NOTHING=0
  else

      mv &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  fi

  return 0
}

function justify_line() {
         local str=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;; local num=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Bash-Function-Args

    local tmp1=$(mktemp)
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; | gawk -v num=$2 &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;
        function justify(szIn,  l,n,i,sz,m,k,A, flag) {
            sz = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;
            n =  split(szIn,A,&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);
            r = 1
            delim = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
            flag=0
            for (i=1; i&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;=n; i++) {
                sz = delim sz A[i] &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;
                delim = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
                l = l + length(A[i] &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);
                if (l &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; (num*r)) {
                    r=r+1;
                    sz = sz &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
                    flag=1
                    delim = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
                }
            }
            if (flag == 1) sz = sz &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
            return sz;
        }
        {
            print justify($0);
        }&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

    cat &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
}
function justify_file() {
         local filename=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;local num=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Bash-Function-Args

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: Filename not provided.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: File &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; not found.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: Number of characters not provided.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  if ! [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Truncate Error: Number of characters must be a positive integer.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi
  if [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; == &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;0&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local temp_file=$(mktemp)

  while IFS= read -r line; do
    justify_line &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$line&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$num&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$temp_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  done &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  mv &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$temp_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  return 0
}

function create_markdown_table4() {
         local input_file=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;local str=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;                   # Bash-Function-Args
  local tmp=$(mktemp)
  local LEN=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  local STRING=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  # Check if the input file exists
  if [[ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
    fecho &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Error: Input file &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; not found.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    return 1
  fi

  LEN=`longest_string_length &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;`
  STRING=`repeat_char &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;-&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;24&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;`

  rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$tmp&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
  if [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$str&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; == &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;MAKELINKS&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]; then
      cat &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; |sort|uniq|gawk &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;{n=split($0,A,&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);print &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;[&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; A[n] &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;](&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; $0 &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;}&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; $tmp
  else
      cat &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$input_file&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; |sort|uniq &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; $tmp
  fi

  # Read lines from the file and create table rows
  local line_count=0
  local row=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  local first_row=1

  while IFS= read -r line; do
    if [[ $line_count -eq 0 ]]; then
      if [[ $first_row -eq 1 ]]; then
          echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;| $STRING | $STRING | $STRING | $STRING |&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
          echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;|----------|----------|----------|----------|&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
          first_row=0
      fi
    fi

    row+=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;| $line &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

    line_count=$((line_count + 1))

    if [[ $line_count -eq 4 ]]; then
      echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$row|&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
      row=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
      line_count=0
    fi
  done &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$tmp&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

  # Handle remaining lines if the total line count is not a multiple of 5
  if [[ $line_count -gt 0 ]]; then
    for ((i = line_count; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 5; i++)); do
        row+=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;|  &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    done
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$row|&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  fi
}

      exit 1

# Trims leading and trailing whitespace from a string.
function trim(str,  trimmed) {
  sub(/^[ \t\r\n]+/, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, str);
  sub(/[ \t\r\n]+$/, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, str);
  return str;
}

# Splits a string into an array based on a delimiter, handles empty fields
function split_preserve_empty(str, arr, delim,  i, field) {
  delete arr;
  i = 1;
  while (match(str, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;([^&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; delim &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;]*)&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; delim &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;?&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, field)) {
    arr[i++] = field[1];
    str = substr(str, RLENGTH + 1);
  }
  if (length(str) &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0) {
    arr[i] = str;
  }
  return i;
}

# Checks if a string starts with a given prefix.
function starts_with(str, prefix) {
  return substr(str, 1, length(prefix)) == prefix;
}

# Checks if a string ends with a given suffix.
function ends_with(str, suffix) {
  return substr(str, length(str) - length(suffix) + 1) == suffix;
}

# Replaces all occurrences of a substring with another string.
function replace_all(str, from, to,  result) {
  result = str;
  while (sub(from, to, result)) {}
  return result;
}

#Checks if a string contains a given substring
function contains(str, sub) {
    return index(str, sub) != 0;
}

# --- Array Manipulation ---

# Checks if an array contains a given value.
function array_contains(arr, val,  i) {
  for (i in arr) {
    if (arr[i] == val) {
      return 1;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

# Joins array elements into a string with a delimiter.
function array_join(arr, delim,  i, result) {
  result = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;
  for (i in arr) {
    result = result (result == &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ? &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; : delim) arr[i];
  }
  return result;
}

#Filters an array based on a given condition (function).
function array_filter(arr, filter_func,  i, new_arr, index) {
    delete new_arr;
    index = 1;
    for (i in arr){
        if(filter_func(arr[i])){
            new_arr[index++] = arr[i];
        }
    }
    return index -1; #Return the size of the new array.
}

#Maps an array to a new array using a function.
function array_map(arr, map_func,  i, new_arr, index){
    delete new_arr;
    index = 1;
    for(i in arr){
        new_arr[index++] = map_func(arr[i]);
    }
    return index -1;
}

# --- Data Processing ---

# Calculates the sum of values in an array.
function array_sum(arr,  i, sum) {
  sum = 0;
  for (i in arr) {
    sum += arr[i];
  }
  return sum;
}

# Calculates the average of values in an array.
function array_average(arr,  sum, count) {
  sum = array_sum(arr);
  count = length(arr);
  if (count == 0) {
    return 0;
  }
  return sum / count;
}

#Parses CSV data into a 2D array.
function parse_csv(data, arr, delimiter,  lines, i, fields, j) {
    lines = split(data, lines, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);
    for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= lines; i++) {
        split_preserve_empty(lines[i], fields, delimiter);
        for (j = 1; j &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= length(fields); j++) {
            arr[i, j] = fields[j];
        }
    }
    return lines;
}

# --- List Operations (Arrays as Lists) ---

# Append an element to the end of a list (array).
function list_append(arr, val,  len) {
  len = length(arr) + 1;
  arr[len] = val;
  return len;
}

# Prepend an element to the beginning of a list (array).
function list_prepend(arr, val,  i, temp_arr, len) {
    len = length(arr);
    for(i = len; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 1; i--){
        temp_arr[i+1] = arr[i];
    }
    arr[1] = val;
    for(i = 2; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len+1; i++){
        arr[i] = temp_arr[i];
    }
    return len +1;
}

# Insert an element at a specific index in a list (array).
function list_insert(arr, index, val,  i, temp_arr, len) {
  len = length(arr);
  if (index &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 1 || index &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; len + 1) {
    return len; # Invalid index, return original length.
  }

  for (i = len; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= index; i--) {
    temp_arr[i + 1] = arr[i];
  }
  arr[index] = val;
  for (i = index + 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len + 1; i++) {
    arr[i] = temp_arr[i];
  }
  return len + 1;
}

# Remove an element at a specific index in a list (array).
function list_remove_at(arr, index,  i, len) {
  len = length(arr);
  if (index &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 1 || index &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; len) {
    return len; # Invalid index, return original length.
  }

  for (i = index; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; len; i++) {
    arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
  }
  delete arr[len];
  return len - 1;
}

# Remove the first occurrence of a value from a list (array).
function list_remove_value(arr, val,  i, len) {
  len = length(arr);
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len; i++) {
    if (arr[i] == val) {
      list_remove_at(arr, i);
      return len - 1;
    }
  }
  return len; # Value not found, return original length.
}

# Get the element at a specific index in a list (array).
function list_get(arr, index,  len) {
  len = length(arr);
  if (index &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 1 || index &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; len) {
    return &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;; # Invalid index, return empty string.
  }
  return arr[index];
}

# Get the index of the first occurrence of a value in a list (array).
function list_index_of(arr, val,  i, len) {
  len = length(arr);
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len; i++) {
    if (arr[i] == val) {
      return i;
    }
  }
  return -1; # Value not found, return -1.
}

# Get the last index of a value in a list (array).
function list_last_index_of(arr, val, i, len, last_index){
    len = length(arr);
    last_index = -1;
    for(i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len; i++){
        if(arr[i] == val){
            last_index = i;
        }
    }
    return last_index;
}

# Reverse a list (array).
function list_reverse(arr,  i, len, temp_arr) {
  len = length(arr);
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len; i++) {
    temp_arr[i] = arr[i];
  }
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len; i++) {
    arr[i] = temp_arr[len - i + 1];
  }
  return len;
}

# Slice a list (array) from start_index to end_index (inclusive).
function list_slice(arr, start_index, end_index,  i, len, new_arr, new_index) {
  len = length(arr);
  if (start_index &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 1) {
    start_index = 1;
  }
  if (end_index &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; len) {
    end_index = len;
  }
  if (start_index &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; end_index) {
    return 0; # Empty slice, return 0.
  }

  delete new_arr;
  new_index = 1;
  for (i = start_index; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= end_index; i++) {
    new_arr[new_index++] = arr[i];
  }
  return new_index - 1;
}

# Concatenate two lists (arrays).
function list_concat(arr1, arr2,  i, len1, len2, new_arr, new_index) {
  len1 = length(arr1);
  len2 = length(arr2);
  delete new_arr;
  new_index = 1;
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len1; i++) {
    new_arr[new_index++] = arr1[i];
  }
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= len2; i++) {
    new_arr[new_index++] = arr2[i];
  }
  return new_index - 1;
}

# --- Example Usage (Illustrative) ---

  # String manipulation examples
  str = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;   hello world   &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;
  print &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;[&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; trim(str) &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;]&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;

  text = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;apple,banana,,orange&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;
  count = split_preserve_empty(text, fruits, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);
  for (i = 1; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= count; i++) {

  }

  print starts_with(&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;awk is fun&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;awk&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);
  print ends_with(&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;awk is fun&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;fun&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);
  print replace_all(&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;awk is fun&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;fun&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;powerful&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);

  # CSV parsing example
  csv_data = &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;name,age,city\nJohn,30,New York\nJane,25,London&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;
  rows = parse_csv(csv_data, csv_array, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;);

  }

  # Array filter and map examples
  function is_even(num){return num % 2 == 0;}
  even_count = array_filter(numbers, &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;is_even&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, even_numbers);

  list[1] = 10; list[2] = 20; list[3] = 30;

#!/usr/bin/bash
Tmp=/tmp/$$
Tmp1=/tmp/$$_$$
Tmp2=/tmp/$$_$$_$$
Tmp3=/tmp/$$_$$_$$_$$
trap &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;exit 0&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; INT HUP QUIT TERM ALRM USR1
trap &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp3&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; EXIT
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp3&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
#================================================================

source ~/bash.library

filename=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

# Check if a filename is are provided
if [ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]; then
  fecho &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Usage: &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  exit 1
fi

# Check if the files exist
if [ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]; then
  fecho &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Error: File &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; not found.&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
  exit 1
fi

indent_file &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$filename&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

Global

:h[elp] keyword - open help for keyword
:sav[eas] file - save file as
:clo[se] - close current pane
:ter[minal] - open a terminal window
K - open man page for word under the cursor
Tip Run vimtutor in a terminal to learn the first Vim commands.

Cursor movement

h - move cursor left
j - move cursor down
k - move cursor up
l - move cursor right
gj - move cursor down (multi-line text)
gk - move cursor up (multi-line text)
H - move to top of screen
M - move to middle of screen
L - move to bottom of screen
w - jump forwards to the start of a word
W - jump forwards to the start of a word (words can contain punctuation)
e - jump forwards to the end of a word
E - jump forwards to the end of a word (words can contain punctuation)
b - jump backwards to the start of a word
B - jump backwards to the start of a word (words can contain punctuation)
ge - jump backwards to the end of a word
gE - jump backwards to the end of a word (words can contain punctuation)
% - move cursor to matching character (default supported pairs: &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;()&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;{}&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;[]&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; 
- use :h matchpairs in vim for more info)
0 - jump to the start of the line
^ - jump to the first non-blank character of the line
$ - jump to the end of the line
g_ - jump to the last non-blank character of the line
gg - go to the first line of the document
G - go to the last line of the document
5gg or 5G - go to line 5
gd - move to local declaration
gD - move to global declaration
fx - jump to next occurrence of character x
tx - jump to before next occurrence of character x
Fx - jump to the previous occurrence of character x
Tx - jump to after previous occurrence of character x
; - repeat previous f, t, F or T movement
, - repeat previous f, t, F or T movement, backwards
} - jump to next paragraph (or function/block, when editing code)
{ - jump to previous paragraph (or function/block, when editing code)
zz - center cursor on screen
zt - position cursor on top of the screen
zb - position cursor on bottom of the screen
Ctrl + e - move screen down one line (without moving cursor)
Ctrl + y - move screen up one line (without moving cursor)
Ctrl + b - move screen up one page (cursor to last line)
Ctrl + f - move screen down one page (cursor to first line)
Ctrl + d - move cursor and screen down 1/2 page
Ctrl + u - move cursor and screen up 1/2 page

Insert mode - inserting/appending text

i - insert before the cursor
I - insert at the beginning of the line
a - insert (append) after the cursor
A - insert (append) at the end of the line
o - append (open) a new line below the current line
O - append (open) a new line above the current line
ea - insert (append) at the end of the word
Ctrl + h - delete the character before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + w - delete word before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + j - add a line break at the cursor position during insert mode
Ctrl + t - indent (move right) line one shiftwidth during insert mode
Ctrl + d - de-indent (move left) line one shiftwidth during insert mode
Ctrl + n - insert (auto-complete) next match before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + p - insert (auto-complete) previous match before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + rx - insert the contents of register x
Ctrl + ox - Temporarily enter normal mode to issue one normal-mode command x.
Esc or Ctrl + c - exit insert mode

Editing

r - replace a single character.
R - replace more than one character, until ESC is pressed.
J - join line below to the current one with one space in between
gJ - join line below to the current one without space in between
gwip - reflow paragraph
g~ - switch case up to motion
gu - change to lowercase up to motion
gU - change to uppercase up to motion
cc - change (replace) entire line
c$ or C - change (replace) to the end of the line
ciw - change (replace) entire word
cw or ce - change (replace) to the end of the word
s - delete character and substitute text (same as cl)
S - delete line and substitute text (same as cc)
xp - transpose two letters (delete and paste)
u - undo
U - restore (undo) last changed line
Ctrl + r - redo
. - repeat last command

Marking text (visual mode)

v - start visual mode, mark lines, then do a command (like y-yank)
V - start linewise visual mode
o - move to other end of marked area
Ctrl + v - start visual block mode
O - move to other corner of block
aw - mark a word
ab - a block with ()
aB - a block with {}
at - a block with &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; tags
ib - inner block with ()
iB - inner block with {}
it - inner block with &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; tags
Esc or Ctrl + c - exit visual mode

Visual commands

&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; - shift text right
&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; - shift text left
y - yank (copy) marked text
d - delete marked text
~ - switch case
u - change marked text to lowercase
U - change marked text to uppercase

Registers

:reg[isters] - show registers content
&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;xy - yank into register x
&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;xp - paste contents of register x
&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;+y - yank into the system clipboard register
&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;+p - paste from the system clipboard register
Tip Registers are being stored in ~/.viminfo, and will be loaded again on next restart of vim.

Special registers:

0 - last yank
&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; - unnamed register, last delete or yank
% - current file name
# - alternate file name
* - clipboard contents (X11 primary)
+ - clipboard contents (X11 clipboard)
/ - last search pattern
: - last command-line
. - last inserted text
- - last small (less than a line) delete
= - expression register
_ - black hole register

Marks and positions

:marks - list of marks
ma - set current position for mark A
`a - jump to position of mark A
y`a - yank text to position of mark A
`0 - go to the position where Vim was previously exited
`&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; - go to the position when last editing this file
`. - go to the position of the last change in this file
`` - go to the position before the last jump
:ju[mps] - list of jumps
Ctrl + i - go to newer position in jump list
Ctrl + o - go to older position in jump list
:changes - list of changes
g, - go to newer position in change list
g; - go to older position in change list
Ctrl + ] - jump to the tag under cursor
Tip To jump to a mark you can either use a backtick (`) or an apostrophe (&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;).
Using an apostrophe jumps to the beginning (first non-blank) of the line holding the mark.

Macros

qa - record macro a
q - stop recording macro
@a - run macro a
@@ - rerun last run macro

Cut and paste

yy - yank (copy) a line
2yy - yank (copy) 2 lines
yw - yank (copy) the characters of the word from the cursor position to the start of the next word
yiw - yank (copy) word under the cursor
yaw - yank (copy) word under the cursor and the space after or before it
y$ or Y - yank (copy) to end of line
p - put (paste) the clipboard after cursor
P - put (paste) before cursor
gp - put (paste) the clipboard after cursor and leave cursor after the new text
gP - put (paste) before cursor and leave cursor after the new text
dd - delete (cut) a line
2dd - delete (cut) 2 lines
dw - delete (cut) the characters of the word from the cursor position to the start of the next word
diw - delete (cut) word under the cursor
daw - delete (cut) word under the cursor and the space after or before it
:3,5d - delete lines starting from 3 to 5
Tip You can also use the following characters to specify the range:
e.g.
:.,$d - From the current line to the end of the file
:.,1d - From the current line to the beginning of the file
:10,1d - From the 10th line to the beginning of the file
:g/{pattern}/d - delete all lines containing pattern
:g!/{pattern}/d - delete all lines not containing pattern
d$ or D - delete (cut) to the end of the line
x - delete (cut) character

Indent text

&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; - indent (move right) line one shiftwidth
&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; - de-indent (move left) line one shiftwidth
&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;% - indent a block with () or {} (cursor on brace)
&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;% - de-indent a block with () or {} (cursor on brace)
&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;ib - indent inner block with ()
&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;at - indent a block with &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; tags
3== - re-indent 3 lines
=% - re-indent a block with () or {} (cursor on brace)
=iB - re-indent inner block with {}
gg=G - re-indent entire buffer
]p - paste and adjust indent to current line

Exiting

:w - write (save) the file, but don&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;t exit
:w !sudo tee % - write out the current file using sudo
:wq or :x or ZZ - write (save) and quit
:q - quit (fails if there are unsaved changes)
:q! or ZQ - quit and throw away unsaved changes
:wqa - write (save) and quit on all tabs

Search and replace

/pattern - search for pattern
?pattern - search backward for pattern
\vpattern - &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;very magic&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; pattern: non-alphanumeric characters are interpreted as special regex symbols (no escaping needed)
n - repeat search in same direction
N - repeat search in opposite direction
:%s/old/new/g - replace all old with new throughout file
:%s/old/new/gc - replace all old with new throughout file with confirmations
:noh[lsearch] - remove highlighting of search matches

Search in multiple files

:vim[grep] /pattern/ {`{file}`} - search for pattern in multiple files
e.g. :vim[grep] /foo/ **/*
:cn[ext] - jump to the next match
:cp[revious] - jump to the previous match
:cope[n] - open a window containing the list of matches
:ccl[ose] - close the quickfix window

Tabs

:tabnew or :tabnew {page.words.file} - open a file in a new tab
Ctrl + wT - move the current split window into its own tab
gt or :tabn[ext] - move to the next tab
gT or :tabp[revious] - move to the previous tab
#gt - move to tab number #
:tabm[ove] # - move current tab to the #th position (indexed from 0)
:tabc[lose] - close the current tab and all its windows
:tabo[nly] - close all tabs except for the current one
:tabdo command - run the command on all tabs (e.g. :tabdo q - closes all opened tabs)

Working with multiple files

:e[dit] file - edit a file in a new buffer
:bn[ext] - go to the next buffer
:bp[revious] - go to the previous buffer
:bd[elete] - delete a buffer (close a file)
:b[uffer]# - go to a buffer by index #
:b[uffer] file - go to a buffer by file
:ls or :buffers - list all open buffers
:sp[lit] file - open a file in a new buffer and split window
:vs[plit] file - open a file in a new buffer and vertically split window
:vert[ical] ba[ll] - edit all buffers as vertical windows
:tab ba[ll] - edit all buffers as tabs
Ctrl + ws - split window
Ctrl + wv - split window vertically
Ctrl + ww - switch windows
Ctrl + wq - quit a window
Ctrl + wx - exchange current window with next one
Ctrl + w= - make all windows equal height &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; width
Ctrl + wh - move cursor to the left window (vertical split)
Ctrl + wl - move cursor to the right window (vertical split)
Ctrl + wj - move cursor to the window below (horizontal split)
Ctrl + wk - move cursor to the window above (horizontal split)
Ctrl + wH - make current window full height at far left (leftmost vertical window)
Ctrl + wL - make current window full height at far right (rightmost vertical window)
Ctrl + wJ - make current window full width at the very bottom (bottommost horizontal window)
Ctrl + wK - make current window full width at the very top (topmost horizontal window)

Diff

zf - manually define a fold up to motion
zd - delete fold under the cursor
za - toggle fold under the cursor
zo - open fold under the cursor
zc - close fold under the cursor
zr - reduce (open) all folds by one level
zm - fold more (close) all folds by one level
zi - toggle folding functionality
]c - jump to start of next change
[c - jump to start of previous change
do or :diffg[et] - obtain (get) difference (from other buffer)
dp or :diffpu[t] - put difference (to other buffer)
:diffthis - make current window part of diff
:dif[fupdate] - update differences
:diffo[ff] - switch off diff mode for current window

#!/usr/bin/bash
Tmp=/tmp/$$
Tmp1=/tmp/$$_$$
Tmp2=/tmp/$$_$$_$$
Tmp3=/tmp/$$_$$_$$_$$
trap &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;exit 0&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; INT HUP QUIT TERM ALRM USR1
trap &amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp3&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; EXIT
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp1&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp2&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
rm -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$Tmp3&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  &amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;/dev/null 2&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;1
#================================================================

source ~/bash.library

INDENT=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
DELIM=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
BAR=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
SPACE=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
W=32

while getopts &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;isn:f:c&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; arg
do
    case $arg in
        i) INDENT=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;YES&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
           echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$INDENT&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
           ;;
        s) SPACE=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;    &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
           ;;
        n) W=$OPTARG
           ;;
        f) DELIM=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
           justify_file &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$OPTARG&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$W&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
           exit 0
           ;;
        c) DELIM=&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
           ;;
    esac
done
shift $(($OPTIND - 1))
echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$INDENT&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

if [ &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$INDENT&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; == &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;YES&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]; then    
    indent_file &amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$OPTARG&amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
fi

# *********************************************************DATEOMATIC: Mon Mar 24 11:21:36 EDT 2025
# *********************************************************HASHOMATIC: e5bceedce2750c47d9d26c395afd43b0
# ~/.bashrc: executed by bash(1) for non-login shells.
# see /usr/share/doc/bash/examples/startup-files (in the package bash-doc)
# for examples

# If not running interactively, don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;t do anything
case $- in
    *i*) ;;
      *) return;;
esac

# don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;t put duplicate lines or lines starting with space in the history.
# See bash(1) for more options
HISTCONTROL=ignoreboth

# append to the history file, don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;t overwrite it
shopt -s histappend

# for setting history length see HISTSIZE and HISTFILESIZE in bash(1)
HISTSIZE=1000
HISTFILESIZE=2000

# check the window size after each command and, if necessary,
# update the values of LINES and COLUMNS.
shopt -s checkwinsize

# If set, the pattern &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;**&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; used in a pathname expansion context will
# match all files and zero or more directories and subdirectories.
#shopt -s globstar

# make less more friendly for non-text input files, see lesspipe(1)
[ -x /usr/bin/lesspipe ] &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; eval &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$(SHELL=/bin/sh lesspipe)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

# set variable identifying the chroot you work in (used in the prompt below)
if [ -z &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${debian_chroot:-}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ] &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; [ -r /etc/debian_chroot ]; then
    debian_chroot=$(cat /etc/debian_chroot)
fi

# disable color support of ls and grep
alias ls=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;ls --color=never&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;
alias grep=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;grep --color=never&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;
alias fgrep=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;fgrep --color=never&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;
alias egrep=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;egrep --color=never&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;

# some more ls aliases
alias ll=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;ls -alF&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;
alias la=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;ls -A&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;
alias l=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;ls -CF&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;

# Add an &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;alert&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; alias for long running commands.  Use like so:
#   sleep 10; alert
alias alert=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;notify-send --urgency=low -i &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$([ $? = 0 ] &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; echo terminal || echo error)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$(history|tail -n1|sed -e &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;s/^\s*[0-9]\+\s*//;s/[;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;|]\s*alert$//&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;

# Alias definitions.
# You may want to put all your additions into a separate file like
# ~/.bash_aliases, instead of adding them here directly.
# See /usr/share/doc/bash-doc/examples in the bash-doc package.

if [ -f ~/.bash_aliases ]; then
    . ~/.bash_aliases
fi

# enable programmable completion features (you don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;t need to enable
# this, if it&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;s already enabled in /etc/bash.bashrc and /etc/profile
# sources /etc/bash.bashrc).
if ! shopt -oq posix; then
  if [ -f /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion ]; then
    . /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion
  elif [ -f /etc/bash_completion ]; then
    . /etc/bash_completion
  fi
fi

source ~/bash.library


source ~/bashrc.shared


export JAVA_HOME=/home/mestes/jdk-23.0.2
export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p                     ~/BACKUPS
backup_file   .bashrc        ~/BACKUPS
backup_file   bashrc.shared  ~/BACKUPS
backup_file   bash.library   ~/BACKUPS
backup_file   .vimrc         ~/BACKUPS

                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Indent and Tab  Setup
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; *************************************************************************************
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; There are in fact four main methods available for indentation, each one
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; overrides the previous if it is enabled, or non-empty for &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;indentexpr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;autoindent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;  uses the indent from the previous line.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;               When opening a new line and no filetype-specific indenting is enabled, keep same
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;               indent as line currently on.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;smartindent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; is like &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;autoindent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; but also recognizes some C syntax to
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;       increase/reduce the indent where appropriate.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;cindent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; Works more cleverly than the other two and is configurable to
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;       different indenting styles.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;indentexpr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;  The most flexible of all: Evaluates an expression to compute
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;       the indent of a line.  When non-empty this method overrides
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;       the other ones.  See |indent-expression|.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; set cindent                       
set tabstop=4 softtabstop=4
set shiftwidth=4     &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Indent settings for using 4 spaces instead of tabs.
                     &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Do not change &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;tabstop&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; from its default value of 8 
set expandtab
set smartindent

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  :copen &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Open the quickfix window

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;  :cw    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Open it if there are &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;errors&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, close it otherwise (some people prefer this)

function g:LogMessage(...)
    let l:ret = 0

    let l:messages=[]
    call add(l:messages, a:1)
    call writefile(l:messages, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/tmp/vimscript.log&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;a&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
    return l:ret
endfunction

         augroup END
    endif
    if ( argc() == 1 ) 
         let s:n=match(argv(0), &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;vimsession$&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
         if (s:n&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;0)
             let $VIMFIRSTFILE=argv(0)
             let s:temp = argv(0)
             let s:temp = substitute(s:temp, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;.vimsession$&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
             let $VIMSESSION=s:temp
             let $VIMWINDOW=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;NIL&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
             let $VIMSPLIT=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;NIL&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
             if ( 1 == 1 )

                 autocmd!

function! MultiToggle()
    let sMt=[]
    call add(sMt, [0, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Upper Mode&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,                  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;:call ToUpperUnderCursor()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [1, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Lower Mode&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,                  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;:call ToLowerUnderCursor()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [2, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;ls&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,                          &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;:ls&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [3 ,&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Edit dots and configs&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,       &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;:call EditDotFiles()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [4, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Open Vim Sheatsheet&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,         &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;:e ~/.vim/vimbrief.txt&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [5, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Reselect Visual Selection&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,   &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;gv&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [6, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Search for Word Under Cursor&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;,&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;:%s/\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;C-r&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;C-w&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;//gI&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;Left&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;Left&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;Left&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [6, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;6One&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Two&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [7, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;7One&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Two&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    call add(sMt, [8, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;8TestMeMe&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;silent nnoremap  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;F7&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; :call g:Test()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ])
    call add(sMt, [9, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;9One&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Two&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;])
    let g:multi_toggle_state = g:multi_toggle_state  + 1
    if g:multi_toggle_state == 7
        let g:multi_toggle_state = 0
    endif
    execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;silent nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;F7&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . sMt[g:multi_toggle_state][2]
    let &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;statusline = sMt[g:multi_toggle_state][1]
endfunction

function! ToLowerUnderCursor()
  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Get the current cursor position.
  let [row, col] = getpos(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;)[1:2]

  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Get the character under the cursor.
  let char = getline(row)[col-1]

  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Check if a character exists at the cursor position (not end of line).
  if char != &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Convert the character to lowercase.
    let lower_char = tolower(char)

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Replace the character under the cursor with the lowercase version.
    call setline(row, strpart(getline(row), 0, col-1) . lower_char . strpart(getline(row), col))

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Restore the cursor position (important!).
    call cursor(row, col)
  endif
endfunction
function! ToUpperUnderCursor()
  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Get the current cursor position.
  let [row, col] = getpos(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;)[1:2]

  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Get the character under the cursor.
  let char = getline(row)[col-1]

  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Check if a character exists at the cursor position (not end of line).
  if char != &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Convert the character to uppercase.
    let upper_char = toupper(char)

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Replace the character under the cursor with the uppercase version.
    call setline(row, strpart(getline(row), 0, col-1) . upper_char . strpart(getline(row), col))

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Restore the cursor position (important!).
    call cursor(row, col)
  endif
endfunction

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Map a key to call the function.  For example, map &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;Leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;u to it.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; You can choose any key combination you prefer.  &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;Leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; is often \.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; See :help leader for more about setting the leader key.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Example:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; hello
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 1: Add the current file
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gaf :!git add %&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 2: Add the current file and stage changes
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gac :!git add % &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; git commit -m &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Staged changes&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 3: Add all changes in the current directory
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gaa :!git add .&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 4: Add all changes in the current directory and stage changes
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gss :!git add . &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; git commit -m &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Staged all changes&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 5: Add the current file and show git status
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gas :!git add %&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;:!git status&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 6: Add all changes in the current directory and show git status
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gaas :!git add .&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;:!git status&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 7: Add the current file and run a custom git command
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gac :!git add % &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; git commit -m &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;C-r&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;=@%&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Option 8: Add all changes in the current directory and run a custom git command
nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;leader&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;gacc :!git add . &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; git commit -m &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;C-r&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;=getcwd()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;


function! g:OpenReadOnlyFileExit()
    silent exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;bd!&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    echom &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
endfunction
function! g:BufferDelete(...)
        if (a:1 == 0)
            nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;silent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;buffer&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; q     :call g:BufferDelete(1)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;silent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;buffer&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;F1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;  :call g:BufferDelete(1)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;silent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;buffer&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;esc&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; :call g:BufferDelete(1)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        else
            silent exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;bd!&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        endif
    echom &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
endfunction
function! g:OpenReadOnlyFile(...)
        let l:filename = a:1
        exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;set nopaste&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        let l:f = l:filename
        if filereadable(l:f)
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; silent exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;tabnew &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:f
            silent execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;edit &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:f
            silent exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;set buftype=nowrite&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
            nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;silent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;buffer&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; q     :call g:OpenReadOnlyFileExit()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;silent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;buffer&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;F1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;  :call g:OpenReadOnlyFileExit()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;silent&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;buffer&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;esc&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; :call g:OpenReadOnlyFileExit()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;cr&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            silent exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;normal gg0&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        endif
        exe &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;set paste&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
endfunction

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;https://www.baeldung.com/linux/vim-find-full-path-current-file#:~:text=The%20%25%20Register,%2C%20depending%20on%20the%20context).
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/usr/bin/git add &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . expand(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;%&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;) . &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;git commit -m \&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Update\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;; git push origin master&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
func! MenuCB(id, result)
    if ( a:result == 1 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;git status &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; /tmp/out&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        call system(l:command)
        call UtilityPopUp(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/tmp/out&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 2 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/usr/bin/git add &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . expand(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;%&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;)
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 3 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;git commit -m \&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Update\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 4 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;git push origin master&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 5 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/usr/bin/git add &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . expand(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;%&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;) . &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;;git commit -m \&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Update\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;; git push origin master&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 6 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;./make&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 7 )
        let l:command = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;./deploy&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;new | r ! &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . l:command
        call g:BufferDelete(0)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 8 )
        call g:UtilityPopupCommand(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;df -h&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 9 )
        call g:UtilityBufferCommand(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;cat /usr/share/vim/vim82/doc/*.txt&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
    endif
    if ( a:result == 10 )
        call g:UtilityBufferCommand(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;cat /usr/share/vim/vim82/doc/pop*.txt&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
    endif

endfunc

func! DoNothingCB(id, result)
    let l:NOTHING=0
endfunc


&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; https://vi.stackexchange.com/questions/24462/what-are-the-new-popup-windows-in-vim-8-2
function! g:GitPopUp()
call popup_menu([&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;Status&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;add&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;commit&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;push&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;all&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;make&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;deploy&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;,&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;df&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;,&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;vim&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;pop&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; ], 
     \ #{ title: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Git&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;, callback: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;MenuCB&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, line: 25, col: 40, 
     \ highlight: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;Question&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, border: [], close: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;click&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;,  padding: [1,1,0,1]} )
endfunction




&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; *****************************************************************************************************
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Utility Popup
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; *************************************************************************************
function! g:UtilityPopupCommand(...)
    call system( a:1 . &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; /tmp/out&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; )
    call UtilityPopUp(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/tmp/out&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
endfunction
let g:utilityPopupFilename = &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
function! g:UtilityPopUp(...)
    if filereadable(a:1)
        let g:utilityPopupFilename = a:1 
        call popup_create(readfile(a:1), #{ line: 1, col: 1, border: [], padding: [1,1,1,1] } )
        let l:id = popup_list()[0]
        call popup_move(l:id, #{ line: 2, col: 4, 
                    \ minwidth: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;columns -14,
                    \ maxheight: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lines -8, maxwidth: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;columns -8,
                    \ })
        hi MyPopupColor ctermbg=black guibg=black
        call setwinvar(l:id, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;wincolor&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;MyPopupColor&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;)
        nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;DOWN&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; :call ScrollPopup(1)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;UP&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;   :call ScrollPopup(-1)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;F10&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;  :call UtilityPopUpClear(g:utilityPopupFilename)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    endif
endfunction
function! g:UtilityBufferCommand(...)
    call system( a:1 . &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; /tmp/out&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; )
    call UtilityBuffer(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;/tmp/out&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)
endfunction
function! g:UtilityBuffer(...)
    if filereadable(a:1)
        execute &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;edit &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; . a:1
    endif
endfunction

function! g:UtilityPopUpClear(...)
    call popup_clear(1)
    nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;DOWN&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;down&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;UP&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;   &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;up&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    nnoremap &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;F10&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;  :call UtilityPopUp(g:utilityPopupFilename)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;CR&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
endfunction

function! ScrollPopup(nlines)
    let winids = popup_list()
    if len(winids) == 0
        return
    endif

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Ignore hidden popups
    let prop = popup_getpos(winids[0])
    if prop.visible != 1
        return
    endif

    let firstline = prop.firstline + a:nlines
    let buf_lastline = str2nr(trim(win_execute(winids[0], &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;echo line(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;$&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;)&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)))
    if firstline &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 1
        let firstline = 1
    elseif prop.lastline + a:nlines &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; buf_lastline
        let firstline = buf_lastline + prop.firstline - prop.lastline
    endif

    call popup_setoptions(winids[0], {&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;firstline&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;: firstline})
endfunction


#######################################################################################################
Processing file: a
       
  __ _ 
 / _` |
| (_| |
 \__,_|
       
Global

:h[elp] keyword - open help for keyword
:sav[eas] file - save file as
:clo[se] - close current pane
:ter[minal] - open a terminal window
K - open man page for word under the cursor
Tip Run vimtutor in a terminal to learn the first Vim commands.

Cursor movement

h - move cursor left
j - move cursor down
k - move cursor up
l - move cursor right
gj - move cursor down (multi-line text)
gk - move cursor up (multi-line text)
H - move to top of screen
M - move to middle of screen
L - move to bottom of screen
w - jump forwards to the start of a word
W - jump forwards to the start of a word (words can contain punctuation)
e - jump forwards to the end of a word
E - jump forwards to the end of a word (words can contain punctuation)
b - jump backwards to the start of a word
B - jump backwards to the start of a word (words can contain punctuation)
ge - jump backwards to the end of a word
gE - jump backwards to the end of a word (words can contain punctuation)
% - move cursor to matching character (default supported pairs: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;()&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;{}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;[]&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; 
- use :h matchpairs in vim for more info)
0 - jump to the start of the line
^ - jump to the first non-blank character of the line
$ - jump to the end of the line
g_ - jump to the last non-blank character of the line
gg - go to the first line of the document
G - go to the last line of the document
5gg or 5G - go to line 5
gd - move to local declaration
gD - move to global declaration
fx - jump to next occurrence of character x
tx - jump to before next occurrence of character x
Fx - jump to the previous occurrence of character x
Tx - jump to after previous occurrence of character x
; - repeat previous f, t, F or T movement
, - repeat previous f, t, F or T movement, backwards
} - jump to next paragraph (or function/block, when editing code)
{ - jump to previous paragraph (or function/block, when editing code)
zz - center cursor on screen
zt - position cursor on top of the screen
zb - position cursor on bottom of the screen
Ctrl + e - move screen down one line (without moving cursor)
Ctrl + y - move screen up one line (without moving cursor)
Ctrl + b - move screen up one page (cursor to last line)
Ctrl + f - move screen down one page (cursor to first line)
Ctrl + d - move cursor and screen down 1/2 page
Ctrl + u - move cursor and screen up 1/2 page

Insert mode - inserting/appending text

i - insert before the cursor
I - insert at the beginning of the line
a - insert (append) after the cursor
A - insert (append) at the end of the line
o - append (open) a new line below the current line
O - append (open) a new line above the current line
ea - insert (append) at the end of the word
Ctrl + h - delete the character before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + w - delete word before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + j - add a line break at the cursor position during insert mode
Ctrl + t - indent (move right) line one shiftwidth during insert mode
Ctrl + d - de-indent (move left) line one shiftwidth during insert mode
Ctrl + n - insert (auto-complete) next match before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + p - insert (auto-complete) previous match before the cursor during insert mode
Ctrl + rx - insert the contents of register x
Ctrl + ox - Temporarily enter normal mode to issue one normal-mode command x.
Esc or Ctrl + c - exit insert mode

Editing

r - replace a single character.
R - replace more than one character, until ESC is pressed.
J - join line below to the current one with one space in between
gJ - join line below to the current one without space in between
gwip - reflow paragraph
g~ - switch case up to motion
gu - change to lowercase up to motion
gU - change to uppercase up to motion
cc - change (replace) entire line
c$ or C - change (replace) to the end of the line
ciw - change (replace) entire word
cw or ce - change (replace) to the end of the word
s - delete character and substitute text (same as cl)
S - delete line and substitute text (same as cc)
xp - transpose two letters (delete and paste)
u - undo
U - restore (undo) last changed line
Ctrl + r - redo
. - repeat last command

Marking text (visual mode)

v - start visual mode, mark lines, then do a command (like y-yank)
V - start linewise visual mode
o - move to other end of marked area
Ctrl + v - start visual block mode
O - move to other corner of block
aw - mark a word
ab - a block with ()
aB - a block with {}
at - a block with &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; tags
ib - inner block with ()
iB - inner block with {}
it - inner block with &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; tags
Esc or Ctrl + c - exit visual mode

Visual commands

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; - shift text right
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; - shift text left
y - yank (copy) marked text
d - delete marked text
~ - switch case
u - change marked text to lowercase
U - change marked text to uppercase

Registers

:reg[isters] - show registers content
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;xy - yank into register x
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;xp - paste contents of register x
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;+y - yank into the system clipboard register
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;+p - paste from the system clipboard register
Tip Registers are being stored in ~/.viminfo, and will be loaded again on next restart of vim.

Special registers:

0 - last yank
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; - unnamed register, last delete or yank
% - current file name
# - alternate file name
* - clipboard contents (X11 primary)
+ - clipboard contents (X11 clipboard)
/ - last search pattern
: - last command-line
. - last inserted text
- - last small (less than a line) delete
= - expression register
_ - black hole register

Marks and positions

:marks - list of marks
ma - set current position for mark A
`a - jump to position of mark A
y`a - yank text to position of mark A
`0 - go to the position where Vim was previously exited
`&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; - go to the position when last editing this file
`. - go to the position of the last change in this file
`` - go to the position before the last jump
:ju[mps] - list of jumps
Ctrl + i - go to newer position in jump list
Ctrl + o - go to older position in jump list
:changes - list of changes
g, - go to newer position in change list
g; - go to older position in change list
Ctrl + ] - jump to the tag under cursor
Tip To jump to a mark you can either use a backtick (`) or an apostrophe (&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;).
Using an apostrophe jumps to the beginning (first non-blank) of the line holding the mark.

Macros

qa - record macro a
q - stop recording macro
@a - run macro a
@@ - rerun last run macro

Cut and paste

yy - yank (copy) a line
2yy - yank (copy) 2 lines
yw - yank (copy) the characters of the word from the cursor position to the start of the next word
yiw - yank (copy) word under the cursor
yaw - yank (copy) word under the cursor and the space after or before it
y$ or Y - yank (copy) to end of line
p - put (paste) the clipboard after cursor
P - put (paste) before cursor
gp - put (paste) the clipboard after cursor and leave cursor after the new text
gP - put (paste) before cursor and leave cursor after the new text
dd - delete (cut) a line
2dd - delete (cut) 2 lines
dw - delete (cut) the characters of the word from the cursor position to the start of the next word
diw - delete (cut) word under the cursor
daw - delete (cut) word under the cursor and the space after or before it
:3,5d - delete lines starting from 3 to 5
Tip You can also use the following characters to specify the range:
e.g.
:.,$d - From the current line to the end of the file
:.,1d - From the current line to the beginning of the file
:10,1d - From the 10th line to the beginning of the file
:g/{pattern}/d - delete all lines containing pattern
:g!/{pattern}/d - delete all lines not containing pattern
d$ or D - delete (cut) to the end of the line
x - delete (cut) character

Indent text

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; - indent (move right) line one shiftwidth
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; - de-indent (move left) line one shiftwidth
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;% - indent a block with () or {} (cursor on brace)
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;% - de-indent a block with () or {} (cursor on brace)
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;ib - indent inner block with ()
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;at - indent a block with &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; tags
3== - re-indent 3 lines
=% - re-indent a block with () or {} (cursor on brace)
=iB - re-indent inner block with {}
gg=G - re-indent entire buffer
]p - paste and adjust indent to current line

Exiting

:w - write (save) the file, but don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;t exit
:w !sudo tee % - write out the current file using sudo
:wq or :x or ZZ - write (save) and quit
:q - quit (fails if there are unsaved changes)
:q! or ZQ - quit and throw away unsaved changes
:wqa - write (save) and quit on all tabs

Search and replace

/pattern - search for pattern
?pattern - search backward for pattern
\vpattern - &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;very magic&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; pattern: non-alphanumeric characters are interpreted as special regex symbols (no escaping needed)
n - repeat search in same direction
N - repeat search in opposite direction
:%s/old/new/g - replace all old with new throughout file
:%s/old/new/gc - replace all old with new throughout file with confirmations
:noh[lsearch] - remove highlighting of search matches

Search in multiple files

:vim[grep] /pattern/ {`{file}`} - search for pattern in multiple files
e.g. :vim[grep] /foo/ **/*
:cn[ext] - jump to the next match
:cp[revious] - jump to the previous match
:cope[n] - open a window containing the list of matches
:ccl[ose] - close the quickfix window

Tabs

:tabnew or :tabnew {page.words.file} - open a file in a new tab
Ctrl + wT - move the current split window into its own tab
gt or :tabn[ext] - move to the next tab
gT or :tabp[revious] - move to the previous tab
#gt - move to tab number #
:tabm[ove] # - move current tab to the #th position (indexed from 0)
:tabc[lose] - close the current tab and all its windows
:tabo[nly] - close all tabs except for the current one
:tabdo command - run the command on all tabs (e.g. :tabdo q - closes all opened tabs)

Working with multiple files

:e[dit] file - edit a file in a new buffer
:bn[ext] - go to the next buffer
:bp[revious] - go to the previous buffer
:bd[elete] - delete a buffer (close a file)
:b[uffer]# - go to a buffer by index #
:b[uffer] file - go to a buffer by file
:ls or :buffers - list all open buffers
:sp[lit] file - open a file in a new buffer and split window
:vs[plit] file - open a file in a new buffer and vertically split window
:vert[ical] ba[ll] - edit all buffers as vertical windows
:tab ba[ll] - edit all buffers as tabs
Ctrl + ws - split window
Ctrl + wv - split window vertically
Ctrl + ww - switch windows
Ctrl + wq - quit a window
Ctrl + wx - exchange current window with next one
Ctrl + w= - make all windows equal height &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; width
Ctrl + wh - move cursor to the left window (vertical split)
Ctrl + wl - move cursor to the right window (vertical split)
Ctrl + wj - move cursor to the window below (horizontal split)
Ctrl + wk - move cursor to the window above (horizontal split)
Ctrl + wH - make current window full height at far left (leftmost vertical window)
Ctrl + wL - make current window full height at far right (rightmost vertical window)
Ctrl + wJ - make current window full width at the very bottom (bottommost horizontal window)
Ctrl + wK - make current window full width at the very top (topmost horizontal window)

Diff

zf - manually define a fold up to motion
zd - delete fold under the cursor
za - toggle fold under the cursor
zo - open fold under the cursor
zc - close fold under the cursor
zr - reduce (open) all folds by one level
zm - fold more (close) all folds by one level
zi - toggle folding functionality
]c - jump to start of next change
[c - jump to start of previous change
do or :diffg[et] - obtain (get) difference (from other buffer)
dp or :diffpu[t] - put difference (to other buffer)
:diffthis - make current window part of diff
:dif[fupdate] - update differences
:diffo[ff] - switch off diff mode for current window

############################################################################################
# ./BashDirName.sh
############################################################################################
No need for basename, and especially no need for a subshell running pwd (which adds an extra, and expensive, fork operation); the shell can do this internally using parameter expansion:

result=${PWD##*/}          # to assign to a variable
result=${result:-/}        # to correct for the case where PWD=/

printf &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;%s\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${PWD##*/}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # to print to stdout
                           # ...more robust than echo for unusual names
                           #    (consider a directory named -e or -n)

printf &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;%q\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${PWD##*/}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # to print to stdout, quoted for use as shell input
                           # ...useful to make hidden characters readable.
Note that if you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;re applying this technique in other circumstances (not PWD, but some other variable holding a directory name), you might need to trim any trailing slashes. The below uses bash&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;s extglob support to work even with multiple trailing slashes:

dirname=/path/to/somewhere//
shopt -s extglob           # enable +(...) glob syntax
result=${dirname%%+(/)}    # trim however many trailing slashes exist
result=${result##*/}       # remove everything before the last / that still remains
result=${result:-/}        # correct for dirname=/ case
printf &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;%s\n&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$result&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;

#Check if file exists

if [[ -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; ]]
then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; exists on your filesystem.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
fi


# Check if file does not exist

if [[ ! -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; ]]
then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; does not exist on your filesystem.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
fi


# Check if directory exist

if [[ -d &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$DIRECTORY&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]]
then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$DIRECTORY exists on your filesystem.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
fi

#     &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;database_url[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*[\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;]?[^\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;]*[\&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;]?&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; # Database URL

# )
. ./secure_patterns

# Define file types to search (customize as needed)
file_types=(&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.sh&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.py&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.js&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.php&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.xml&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.json&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.txt&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.conf&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.yaml&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.yml&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.sh&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.bash&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.c&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.cpp&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.java&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.go&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;)


# Function to search a single file
search_file() {
    local file=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    local line_num
    local line

    for pattern in &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${patterns[@]}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;; do
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            line_num=$((line_num + 1))
            if [[ &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$line&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; =~ $pattern ]]; then
                echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;File: $file, Line: $line_num: $line, Pattern: $pattern&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; $Tmp
            fi
        done &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
        line_num=0 # Reset line number for next pattern
    done
}

# Find files and search them
# find . \( -name &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;${file_types[@]}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d $&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;\0&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; file; do
find . \( -name &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;*.sh&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d $&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;\0&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39; file; do
    if [ -f &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; ]; then # Check if it&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#39;s a regular file (not a directory)
      search_file &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;$file&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    fi
done



if [ -f $Tmp ]; then
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;!!!!    Secrets Found    !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
    cat $Tmp | sort | uniq
    exit 1
fi

echo &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;Finished searching.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
exit 0
